## Stennos Vanilla+
Contains nearly all of the [Stennos Packs](https://modrinth.com/user/Stennos), with the exception of the Utility Packs ([Darker Desert](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/darkerdesert), [Clear Glass](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/clearglass), [Customizations](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/stennoscustomizations)).


---


## Features
- This is the primary catch-all pack for Stennos <sup>[[1]](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/stennosvanilla+/gallery)</sup>
- Some changes help with video compression, like brighter blocks, limiting animations
- This pack contains all of my other packs, other than [Stennos Darker Desert](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/darkerdesert), [Stennos Clear Glass](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/clearglass), [Stennos Customizations](https://modrinth.com/project/stennoscustomizations)
- **Full List of Edits** can be found in the [Versions](https://modrinth.com/project/stennosvanilla+/versions) history; start at the bottom, and work your way up.
- <sup>Initially designed for use in [Streams](https://www.twitch.tv/stennos) & [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@Stennos) videos by [Stennos](https://linktr.ee/Stennos)</sup>


<details>
<summary>Install</summary>

- **Option 1:** Click "Download" button > Install with Modrinth App
- **Option 2:** Download > Launch Minecraft: Java Edition > Resource Packs Menu > Open Resource Packs Folder > Copy Resource Pack Downloaded Zip file here > Resource Packs Game Menu > Click Arrow to move “**Stennos Vanilla+**” to the right side

</details>


<details>
<summary>FAQ (optifine?)</summary>

- **Is Optifine Needed?** No, this pack works on it’s own.
- **Mod Support?** I do not play modded, and do not currently plan to add support for mods
- **Do You Have Other Packs?** Yes I do! You can find all of my public packs in my [Modrinth Projects Page](https://modrinth.com/user/Stennos) and find them quickly at [linktr.ee/StennosPacks](https://linktr.ee/StennosPacks)
- **Can I Use Your Textures?** You can use these edited files, and edit them as well, just provide credit to “[Stennos.com](https://stennos.com/)” in the readme file and do not put the pack behind a Pay Wall.
<sup>**License:** [CC BY-NC-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/4.0/)</sup>
- **Can I Leave Feedback?** Yes, you can chat with me directly when I’m [live on Twitch](https://www.twitch.tv/stennos) or in my [Discord](https://tr.ee/StennosDiscord) 
- **Do you like chicken wings?** I could eat chicken wings every day and never get tired of them; that's why I make these packs, so I can get chicken wing money. Feel free to support my happiness if you're rich [![ko-fi](https://wsrv.nl/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fgistcdn.githack.com%2FRoundaround%2F98ecf33ee2e067ca7d7cea091de04307%2Fraw%2Fef54ea02d444dc0ebff3018a34777ece8f71347a%2Fko-fi_button.svg&n=-1)](https://ko-fi.com/stennos)

</details>

## Packs Inside
These packs are contained within Stennos Vanilla+

<summary>Stennos Dark Mode</summary>

## Stennos Dark Mode 😎 <sup>[[Get This Pack]](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/dark-mode)</sup>
Only modifies the GUI to be a consistent dark color scheme, GUI text to be white, and the Book pages to be darker

![StennosDarkMode_Primary](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b5e60862e733368deeb612dac266c4ed1db2e294_0.webp)
</details>

<details>
<summary>Stennos Brewing Guide (Beta version with dark mode)</summary>

## Stennos Brewing Guide <sup>[[Get This Pack]](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/brewingguide)</sup>
Simply adds an easy-to-read brewing guide to the Brewing Stand Menu. Two Versions, a [Release Version](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/brewingguide/version/1.0.0) in default aka Light Mode, and a [Beta Version](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/brewingguide/version/fANqcBxu) in Stennos Dark Mode Style.

![StennosBrewingGuide_Primary](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/bdF6RLws/images/561591fea5351d9800a313a42289d710a9e39fe5.png)
![StennosBrewingGuide_Secondary](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/bdF6RLws/images/337ea78327ec9a2e31300b189d0571c48db35bec.png)
</details> 

<details>
<summary>Stennos Green Savanna</summary>

## Stennos Green Savanna <sup>[[Get This Pack]](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/greensavanna)</sup>
Only modifies the biome color map for the Savanna biome tint

<summary>Stennos Bench Beds</summary>

## Stennos Bench Beds <sup>[[Get This Pack]](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/benchbeds)</sup>
Only retextures the Brown Bed to look like a Spruce Barrel Texture Bench

![StennosBenchBeds_Primary](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/H7L21OU6/images/1d26aa4d702684150d90287e26395122d124f1b8.png)

<details>
<summary>Stennos Stone Beds</summary>

## Stennos Stone Beds <sup>[[Get This Pack]](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/stonebeds)</sup>
Simply retextures the Light Gray Bed to look like a stone Bed made of Polished Andesite.

![StennosStoneBeds_Primary](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/x45MpJxJ/images/ba0c9478975322b321aedd0f0c0a61aaa5ecb756.png)
![StennosStoneBeds_Secondary](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/x45MpJxJ/images/0e223edad4e722cb918dc5970474a79ea758cad0.png)
</details> 

<details>
<summary>Stennos Straw Beds (Beta version with Hay Bales)</summary>

## Stennos Straw Beds <sup>[[Get This Pack]](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/strawbeds)</sup>
Simply retextures the Yellow Bed to look like a Spruce Bed covered in pale straw. Two Versions, a [Release Version](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/strawbeds/version/1.0.0) with retextured **Yellow Bed ONLY**, and a [Beta Version](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/strawbeds/version/pLephKpY) with  retextured Yellow Bed and Hay Bale to match the bed.

![StennosStrawBeds_Primary](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/dalBnxvy/images/287c1f4b546a19d4c26e2fec1285a520c9f76e71.png)
</details> 

<details>
<summary>Stennos Totem Wings</summary>

## Stennos Totem Wings <sup>[[Get This Pack]](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/totemwings)</sup>
Simply changes the golden wings of the Totem of Undying into white wings.

![StennosTotemWings_Primary](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/Tx8nxPoE/images/7490ab13921bdfd3e0936fc5cd561e80f8a75564.png)
</details>


## Packs NOT Included
These packs were intentionally left out of Stennos Vanilla+
- **[Stennos Darker Desert](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/darkerdesert)** - only intended to use while sand mining, to be easy on the eyes
- **[Stennos Clear Glass](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/clearglass)** - you'll need to remove this pack to see regular glass as it's 100% invisible <sup>[[2]](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/clearglass/gallery)</sup>
- **[Stennos Customizations](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/stennoscustomizations)** - these are pretty subjective edits, which is why they have their own pack
- **[My Vanilla Tweaks Selection](https://linktr.ee/StennosPacks)** - easier to update by exclusing this, and allows you to make selections
